# Bug Bounty & Feature Request Program

Thank you for your interest in contributing to QuorumTrust! This program incentivizes developers to identify and resolve bugs, implement features, and improve our codebase.

## How to Participate

- Check existing issues to avoid duplicates.
- Create a detailed issue with reproduction steps or feature description.
- Include environment details (OS, version, dependencies).
- For security issues, report privately via Telegram.
- Include a pull request with a proposed fix or feature (optional but recommended).
- Maintainers will review and assess bounty eligibility.

## Bounty Tiers

| Severity       | Reward Range      | Examples                                  |
| -------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Critical       | $500 - $2,500     | Security vulnerabilities, data loss, complete feature breakdown |
| High           | $250 - $500       | Significant functionality impairment, performance degradation |
| Medium         | $50 - $250        | Partial feature failure, inconsistent behavior, usability issues |
| Low            | $10 - $50         | Minor bugs, documentation improvements, code quality enhancements |
| Feature        | Negotiable        | New features aligned with project roadmap |

## Terms and Conditions

- One submission per person per issue.
- Contributors must follow the project's Code of Conduct.
- Bounties are non-negotiable after payout.
- Quality of submission affects bounty amount.
- Automated or low-effort submissions may be declined.
- Payments processed within 30 days of merge.
- Taxes are the responsibility of the recipient.

## Contact

For security issues or private discussions, please contact the maintainers via Telegram.

---

Thank you for helping improve QuorumTrust!
